id: SACRIFICE AND REBELLION: CLAIRE MABEY AND RACHAEL KING-55 Cable Street, Wellington-Facebook
name: SACRIFICE AND REBELLION: CLAIRE MABEY AND RACHAEL KING
long_description:
Two new novels for young people take readers into imaginary worlds where tyranny holds an iron grip.
Claire Mabey’s The Raven’s Eye Rebellion returns her fans to the medieval world of Wyle, where reading and writing are forbidden.
Rachael King’s folk horror fantasy Song of the Saltings unfolds on the isolated isle of Brack, where a creature that haunts the salt marshes demands an annual sacrifice.
Join these two beloved authors in conversation with Elizabeth Knox, as they discuss these stories of courage and resistance.
Writers on Mondays is presented by the International Institute of Modern Letters and The Museum of New Zealand Te Papa Tongarewa. The 2026 series will run from 12.15—1.15 pm each Monday from 6 July to 28 September at Te Papa and Circa Theatre, with two special evening sessions at Meow. Admission is free and all are welcome. The series is supported by the Letteri family.
The full programme can be viewed here: https://www.wgtn.ac.nz/moder.../about/events/writers-mondays

name: FASHION FEST - Wellington
long_description:
FASHION FEST - Wellington, presented by My Walk in Wardrobe, is a celebration of sustainable fashion, community and self-expression right in the heart of the Wellington CBD.
Bringing together New Zealand’s most sought-after thrift vendors, Fashion Fest transforms the traditional market into an immersive fashion experience.
We open our applications to the wider community & also welcome local businesses whose services celebrate personal style & individuality. Like tattoo artists, barbers, braiders, piercers & more.
Every event is thoughtfully curated to showcase a diverse mix of vendors, so there’s something for EVERYONE to discover.
Whether you’re joining us as a vendor showcasing your brand, an individual ready to clear your closet or a shopper searching for your next favourite find, we invite you to be part of a community that’s redefining the future of fashion, one sustainable choice at a time.
$5 entry at the door

id: Riki Pirihi - Master Drummer - Night 1-Fors, 298 Taranaki St, Te Aro, Wellington 6011, New Zealand-Facebook
name: Riki Pirihi - Master Drummer - Night 1
venue: Fors, 298 Taranaki St, Te Aro, Wellington 6011, New Zealand
long_description:
Pyramid Club is excited to present master drummer Riki Pirihi, in a performance residency over 2 nights and an afternoon participatory Conduction workshop.
Riki Pirihi (Ngāti Wai, Patuharakeke, Ngāti Māhanga) is one of the most important musicians of his generation in Aotearoa. As a drummer he has been the rhythmic force behind a huge number of bands and A-list mucisians including Trinity Roots, Fat Freddy's Drop, Connan Mockasin, Anika Moa, Jonathan Crayford, Crowded House, Recloose, Ladi6, Orchestra of Spheres and Dave Dobbyn to name but a few. Working solo under Cave Circles, Riki is constantly reinventing his music, from experimental electronics to taonga pūoro.
Recently Riki completed a Doctor of Musical Arts degree centred on the cultivation of a unique musical language, Rangatuone, which intertwines the principles of Conduction (improvised conducting) with expressive signs and gestures, tailored specifically for the composition and performance of taonga pūoro alongside Western instruments.
Through all this astonishing variety of musical settings, Riki's foundation has always been in improvisation, and it's with pleasure that we welcome him home to Pyramid Club for two nights of improvised collaborations with a diverse lineup of artists from Wellington's creative music family.
Riki will play solo, duo, trio and quartet sets on both the Friday and Saturday night concerts, and will lead a participatory conduction workshop on Saturday afternoon.
SCHEDULE:
Night 1 - Fri 31 July
Riki Pirihi solo
duo w/ Anthony Donaldson
trio w/ Nell Thomas, Simon O'Rorke
quartet w/ Kiva Pirihi, Erika Grant, Jonny Marks

Night 2 - Saturday 1 August
Riki Pirihi solo
duo w/ Alistair Fraser
trio w/ Daniel Beban, David Long
quartet w/ Bridget Kelly, Tom Callwood, Toby Laing

Saturday 1 August 2:30pm - Conduction Workshop

Thanks to Creative NZ and Wellington City Council for supporting Pyramid Club's programme.

long_description:
2026 Natokbaaj production coming up – mark the date in your calendar!
We’re back again this year with something new! For the first time, Wellington Natokbaaj is going to produce a murder mystery, Nishi-dham Hatya Rahasya (‘Murder at Nishi-dham’).
The plot is adapted from a novel written by the Queen of Crime, Agatha Christie. We have transported the story to the small town of Birpur in the pre-mobile, pre-Internet era of the 1980s. Our two quirky detectives – Tuni and Bulu – solve a murder occurring at the dilapidated mansion ‘Nishi-dham,’ owned by the enigmatic young woman Billie Mullick.
True to the Natokbaaj pledge, we have aimed to blend pure comedy into the narrative; hoping to bring to you an enjoyable experience of fun and excitement with a dash of fear. Come clue-hunting with us!

long_description:
Winterman 2026 – Save the Date!
Saturday 15 August | Meet 7:30am | Freyberg Beach
Winterman is back!
It's become a club tradition, this time with a slightly different course to make use of the new facilities we have in our beautiful Welly.
Whether you're preparing for a long-course event, building fitness through winter, or simply keen to spend a quality day training alongside fellow club members, Winterman is all about getting together, challenging yourself, and enjoying some solid miles with good company.
Choose Your Adventure
You can tackle:
The Full Monty (Half Ironman-style distance)
or
Pick & Mix – choose the distances and disciplines that you feel like doing on the day, no stress
The Full Monty
For those wanting the full experience:
Ocean Swim – 15–20 minutes (conditions permitting)
90km Bike Ride
Start from Freyberg
Follow the new cycleway to Eastbourne and return
Continue over Wainui Hill
Out along the Coast Road to the turnaround point
Return to Freyberg
Approximately 90km total
21km Run
Around the bays
Including the Mt Victoria climb on the return
Finish back at Freyberg
Flexible Options
Not keen on the full distance? No problem.
You can:
Skip the swim or swim later
Do an ocean swim or use the pool afterwards
Ride only to Eastbourne (60k roundtrip) for a shorter bike option
Choose a flatter, shorter run around the bays
Join for just one discipline or any combination that suits
The aim is participation. Come along (you'll push yourself harder when you train with others) and make the most of a great winter day out.
Saturday 15 August
Freyberg Beach
Meet at 7:30am
More details will follow, but for now mark the date in your calendar and start thinking about your Winterman training, join our Saturday group rides or Friday ocean swims to acclimatise
.
We'd love to see you there!

Kiwi rock fans are in for the ultimate celebration of grunge history as The Pearl Jam Experience crosses the Tasman to deliver a definitive, career-spanning greatest hits set. This special tour will honour the massive catalog of the Seattle icons, delivering a full-throttle, high-energy performance packed to the brim with Pearl Jam’s biggest anthems and fan favourites.
Widely regarded as the premier tribute to Pearl Jam, the band is renowned for recreating the atmosphere, the madness, and most importantly, the sonically accurate music that defined a generation.
Their commitment to the music’s authenticity goes beyond the stage. In a remarkable nod to Pearl Jam’s golden era, the band recently recorded a collaborative cover of the hit song Go with former Pearl Jam drummer Dave Abbruzzese. Abbruzzese, who drove the rhythm section during the band's peak explosive years, lent his signature powerful drumming to the track and mixed it for the group.
The Pearl Jam Experience also maintains a deep connection to the band's philanthropic legacy. They are proud supporters of the EB Research Partnership (EBRP), the largest nonprofit funding research for a cure for Epidermolysis Bullosa (EB), co-founded by Jill and Eddie Vedder.
For New Zealand fans, this is the ultimate chance to experience a high-octane concert that embodies the true sound and spirit of Pearl Jam, delivered with the energy, precision, and respect this legendary rock catalog deserves.

Oasis Centre offers Massage by appointment. During your spiritual Massage session you will feel your body, mind and soul nurtured in the most spiritual, unwinding and relaxing way. Mindful healing touch and care is given so that you can receive the full benefit of this experience.
The benefits of Massage Therapy are many and varied, and include:
•Body realignment
•Clarity for the mind
•Motivation
•Pain relief
•Rejuvenation
•Relaxation
•Relief of stress and tension
•Sense of calmness
•Therapeutic tension release
Massage is an excellent therapy for relieving pain and stiffness from the muscles of the face, scalp, neck, body, legs, upper back to the shoulders. We often use hot stones to promote deeper relaxation and muscle release.
Massage/Spiritual Healing is also an effective method to bring about a deep relaxing, enjoyable and harmonious healing. In some cases it will deal with the emotional release that is required at the time.
Come and enjoy the healing atmosphere. Have a Massage session and experience the benefits it gives to your mind, body, soul and spirit.
Each Massage session usually takes about an hour. Bookings are required as spaces are limited.

id: Murder and matters more pressing-Wellington-Facebook
name: Murder and matters more pressing
long_description:
Murders and matters more pressing
Step through the doors of Fardelbear Estate and into an evening of uproarious, upper‑crust mayhem.
Two delightfully incompetent burglars set out to pinch a priceless painting… and instead manage to bump off the lord of the manor.
Naturally, they do what any self‑respecting criminals would do — hide the body and hope no one notices.
Unfortunately, tonight is party night.As guests pour into the very room containing the dearly‑departed, chaos erupts.
Who’s locked inside the iron maiden?
Can you really spot a liar by their dental hygiene?
And, for heaven’s sake, who ate all the boiled eggs?
It’s a riotous romp of mystery, mischief, and manor‑house madness — and you’re invited.
Written by our very own Amelia Lucie‑Smith and directed by Martin Hunt
Add one of these to your diary. Bookings are now open.
Performance dates: Aug 7, 8, 13, 14, 15, 20*, 21, 22
(*20 Aug is a benefit performance)
To book your tickets, head to www.newplayers.org.nz
